    The year climate term of an ignition fit

    fitYearClimate.Rd

    Fits E[O_y] = P_y * exp(beta * z_y), beta >= 0, where P_y and O_y are the out-of-year predicted and observed ignitions of year y (yearTotals) and z_y is the standardised yearly mean of variable (yearClimateMeansOf(): centre is the mean over the fit years of the yearly means, scale their sd). beta is the coefficient of glm(observed ~ 0 + z, offset = log(predicted), family = poisson), floored at 0; it is 0 if the glm fails or nothing is expected.

    fitYearClimate(variable, raw, yearTotals)

    Arguments

    variable

    Covariate name; see yearClimateMeansOf(). The column must be in raw.

    raw

    The raw ignition covariates.

    yearTotals

    The data.frame of outOfFoldYearTotals(): year (calendar year; the fit's is standardised when rescaleVars, so map it through the covariates' rows first), observed, predicted; or NULL.

    Value

    list(variable, center, scale, beta), variable being the covariate's column name.
